text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — finalizing the RC window. Planning to lock main in 1h30 (now +90m). If you need a version bump / changelog entry, drop PRs now. I'll post an announce if anything slips.

Maria: PR #4321 is ready (bump to v1.8.2, changelog entry in changelogs/4321.md). Should be non-breaking.

Sam: hitting an infra flake in CI e2e, might need ~2h to triage. Will update in 20m.

Laura: fyi I'll prepare the #announcements blurb but wait for final ETA. Want to avoid pinging customers twice. :+1:

Ben: if Sam's triage grows, we should consider cutting an RC with what we have and backport the infra fix to an RC patch. Preference?

Alex: Good call. Two options: (A) lock on time and cut RC with PRs merged; (B) slip by a few hours and include Sam's fix. If slip, I'll post to #announcements with reason + ETA. Which does team prefer?

Jia: For whichever path, please ensure CHANGELOG entries are one-line bullets (component: short description). Example snippet I pasted below — helps release notes automation:
```
- runtime: avoid double-kv-cache eviction on short sequences (#4321)
- api: bump version to v1.8.2 for RC (migration note)
```

Maria: pinging CI rerun now. If green in ~10m we can go with option A.

Sam: CI flake is on infra's side, not the change. I'm escalating and will try a hotfix. ETA for fix ~90m. Sorry.

Alex: Okay. That pushes us into decision boundary. Laura — can you draft a short slip notice we can post if needed? Keep it <3 sentences and include new ETA.

Laura: Draft: "Heads-up: the planned RC for today is delayed while we address a CI/infra flake affecting e2e. New ETA: ~3h from now. We expect to ship the same set of PRs once validation completes. Will update when CI is green. — @eng-releases"

Ben: That reads well. Add one line about customer impact: "No customer-facing changes expected; this is internal validation."

Laura: Updated draft: "Heads-up: the planned RC for today is delayed while we address a CI/infra flake affecting end-to-end tests. New ETA: ~3h from now. No customer-facing changes expected; this is internal validation. We expect to ship the same set of PRs once validation completes. — @eng-releases"

Alex: Perfect. If Sam confirms slip, I'll post that to #announcements and pin the changelog PR link.

Sam: Confirming slip. Infra says root cause identified, patch in review. ETA ~3h. Please proceed with slip notice.

Alex: Posting now. release-bot: tag RC when ready (do not auto-promote).

release-bot: Created tag v1.8.2-rc.1 on origin/main at commit abc123 (manual cut requested).

Maria: rebase done, merging changelog & version bump into rc branch.

Jia: Reminder to run release_notes/generate after final merge (scripts/release_notes.sh). Also make sure PR descriptions include the customer-facing bullet.

Alex: Locking main in 30m for branch protection (no further direct pushes; use PRs). If anything critical lands after that, we'll triage for a hotfix.

Laura: I'll post the slip blurb to #announcements now and add the changelog link. Posting: "Heads-up: the planned RC for today is delayed while we address a CI/infra flake affecting end-to-end tests. New ETA: ~3h from now. No customer-facing changes expected; this is internal validation. We expect to ship the same set of PRs once validation completes. — @eng-releases" :loudspeaker:

Ben: Thanks. LMK if we should convert to a patch release instead of bundling — happy to coordinate backports.

Alex: Hold for now. We'll aim for RC with backported patch if needed. I'll send a follow-up if plan changes. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
